translations.literal: He Chong, a subordinate general under Sun Xiu, led five thousand men to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Xiu’s officer He Chong brought five thousand soldiers over to Jin.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，九真太守董元爲吳將虞氾所攻，軍敗，死之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Dong Yuan, prefect of Jiuzhen, was attacked by Wu general Yu Fan; his army was defeated and he died.
translations.idiomatic: Summer: Wu’s Yu Fan crushed Jiuzhen prefect Dong Yuan in the field.

sentences.zh: 北地胡寇金城，涼州刺史牽弘討之。

translations.literal: Northern tribesmen raided Jincheng; Qian Hong, inspector of Liang province, campaigned against them.
translations.idiomatic: Di raiders struck Jincheng; Liang inspector Qian Hong marched to answer.

sentences.zh: 群虜內叛，圍弘於青山，弘軍敗，死之。

translations.literal: The host of tribes mutinied within, surrounded Qian Hong at Qingshan; his army was defeated and he died.
translations.idiomatic: The tribesmen turned, trapped Qian Hong on Mount Qing, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 五月，立皇子憲爲城陽王。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he established the imperial son Xian as king of Chengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xian became king of Chengyang.

sentences.zh: 雍、涼、秦三州饑，赦其境內殊死以下。

translations.literal: Yong, Liang, and Qin provinces suffered famine; he pardoned crimes up to death-without-mercy within their borders.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in Yong, Liang, and Qin brought an amnesty for all but capital crimes there.

sentences.zh: 閏月，大雩，太官減膳。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month he held the great rain prayer; the palace kitchen reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month: a state prayer for rain went with simpler palace fare.

sentences.zh: 詔交趾三郡、南中諸郡，無出今年戶調。

translations.literal: He ordered the three commanderies of Jiaozhi and the southern commanderies to pay no household levy this year.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhi and the deep south were excused from the year’s head tax.

sentences.zh: 六月，詔公卿以下舉將帥各一人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he ordered dukes and ministers downward each to recommend one commander.
translations.idiomatic: June: every minister had to name a general.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大司馬義陽王望薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou grand marshal Sima Wang of Yiyang died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Sima Wang, grand marshal of Yiyang, died.

sentences.zh: 大雨霖，伊、洛、河溢，流居人四千餘家，殺三百餘人，有詔振貸給棺。

translations.literal: Great rains continued; the Yi, Luo, and Yellow River overflowed, sweeping away more than four thousand households and killing more than three hundred persons; an edict ordered relief loans and coffins supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Relentless storms burst the Yi and Luo into the Yellow River, drowning thousands; the court sent grain loans and coffins.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，以車騎將軍賈充爲都督秦、涼二州諸軍事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day guiyou, Jia Chong, general of chariots and cavalry, was appointed supervisor of all military affairs of Qin and Liang provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guiyou: Jia Chong took joint command of Qin and Liang.

sentences.zh: 吳將陶璜等圍交趾，太守楊稷與鬱林太守毛炅及日南等三郡降於吳。

translations.literal: Wu generals including Tao Huang besieged Jiaozhi; prefect Yang Ji together with Mao Jiong of Yulin and the three commanderies of Rinan and others surrendered to Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Huang’s Wu army penned Jiaozhi until Yang Ji, Mao Jiong, and the coast surrendered.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day dingchou, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, dingchou: a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十二月，大雪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month there was heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: December brought blizzards.

sentences.zh: 罷中領軍，并北軍中候。

translations.literal: The central army commandant was abolished and merged into the inspector of the northern armies.
translations.idiomatic: The inner-army commandant post was folded into the northern-army inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 以光祿大夫鄭袤爲司空。

translations.literal: Zheng Mao, grand officer of brilliant prosperity, was appointed minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Mao became minister of works.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月，監軍何楨討匈奴劉猛，累破之，左部帥李恪殺猛而降。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, army supervisor He Zhen campaigned against the Xiongnu Liu Meng, repeatedly defeated him, and Li Ke, leader of the left wing, killed Meng and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, spring: He Zhen broke Liu Meng’s Xiongnu bands until a subchief murdered Meng and yielded.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，帝耕于藉田。

translations.literal: On the day guihai the emperor ploughed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he turned the soil of the ritual field.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，禁彫文綺組非法之物。

translations.literal: On the day yihai of the second month carved patterns and illegal brocade weaves were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yihai: luxury embroidery and illegal weave patterns were banned.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太宰、安平王孚薨。

translations.literal: On the day renchen grand preceptor Sima Fu, king of Anping, died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Sima Fu, grand preceptor and king of Anping, died.

sentences.zh: 詔內外群官舉任邊郡者各三人。

translations.literal: He ordered civil and military officials within and without each to recommend three men fit to serve on frontier commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Every office had to name three candidates willing to serve on the border.

sentences.zh: 帝與右將軍皇甫陶論事，陶與帝爭言，散騎常侍鄭徽表請罪之。

translations.literal: The emperor discussed affairs with general of the right Huangfu Tao; Tao disputed with the emperor in speech, and Zheng Hui, regular attendant of cavalier, memorialized requesting to punish Tao.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Tao argued loudly with the throne; Zheng Hui asked that Tao be prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「讜言謇諤，所望於左右也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: “Straightforward counsel in blunt words is what I expect from those at my side.”
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied, “I want blunt counsel from my attendants.”

sentences.zh: 人主常以阿媚爲患，豈以爭臣爲損哉！

translations.literal: A ruler always takes flattery as the peril; how could contending ministers be a loss!”
translations.idiomatic: Flattery ruins a throne; honest quarrel does not.”

sentences.zh: 徽越職妄奏，豈朕之意。

translations.literal: Hui overstepped his duty with a reckless memorial—how can that be my intent!”
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Hui had no business filing that petition.”

sentences.zh: 」遂免徽官。

translations.literal: Thereupon Hui’s office was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Hui was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，置後將軍，以備四軍。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, a rear general was established to complete the four armies.
translations.idiomatic: Summer: a rear general was added to balance the four-army set.

sentences.zh: 六月，益州牙門張弘誣其刺史皇甫晏反，殺之，傳首京師。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Zhang Hong, camp gate officer of Yi province, falsely accused his inspector Huangfu Yan of rebellion, killed him, and sent the head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: June: Yi’s gate captain Zhang Hong murdered inspector Huangfu Yan on a false charge of treason.

sentences.zh: 弘坐伏誅，夷三族。

translations.literal: Hong was judged guilty and executed, and his three kinships were exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hong was executed and his kin to the third degree wiped out.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day renchen a great amnesty was declared.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen came a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔復隴右四郡遇寇害者田租。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen an edict remitted field rent for the four Longyou commanderies that had suffered bandit harm.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the four raided Longyou counties were forgiven their grain rent.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以車騎將軍賈充爲司空。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Jia Chong, general of chariots and cavalry, was appointed minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Jia Chong traded his army command for the ministry of works.

sentences.zh: 九月，吳西陵督步闡來降，拜衛將軍、開府儀同三司，封宜都公。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Bu Chan, Wu’s commander at Xiling, came to surrender; he was appointed guard general with independent command equal to the three excellencies and enfeoffed as duke of Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: September: Bu Chan defected from Wu’s Xiling garrison and received guard-general rank and a ducal title.

sentences.zh: 吳將陸抗攻闡，遣車騎將軍羊祜帥眾出江陵，荊州刺史楊肇迎闡於西陵，巴東監軍徐胤擊建平以救闡。

translations.literal: Wu general Lu Kang attacked Chan; chariots-and-cavalry general Yang Hu led a host out from Jiangling; Yang Zhao, inspector of Jing, went to welcome Chan at Xiling; Xu Yin, army supervisor of Badong, struck Jianping to relieve Chan.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Kang besieged Bu Chan while Yang Hu marched from Jiangling, Yang Zhao raced to Xiling, and Xu Yin hit Jianping to break the ring.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day xinwei, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, new moon on xinwei: eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 十二月，肇攻抗，不克而還。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Yang Zhao attacked Lu Kang, did not overcome him, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: December: Yang Zhao failed against Lu Kang and pulled back.

sentences.zh: 闡城陷，爲抗所禽。

translations.literal: Chan’s city fell and he was captured by Kang.
translations.idiomatic: Xiling fell and Bu Chan fell into Lu Kang’s hands.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月辛酉，司空、密陵侯鄭袤薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on the day xinyou, Zheng Mao, minister of works and marquis of Miling, died.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year, xinyou: minister Zheng Mao died.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，司徒、樂陵公石苞薨。

translations.literal: On the day guisi of the second month Shi Bao, steward of the masters of the people and duke of Leling, died.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guisi: Shi Bao, steward of the masters of the people, died.

sentences.zh: 立安平亭侯隆爲安平王。

translations.literal: He established Long, marquis of the village of Anping, as king of Anping.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Long of Anping village was promoted to king of Anping.

sentences.zh: 三月，立皇子祗爲東海王。

translations.literal: In the third month he established the imperial son Zhi as king of Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhi became king of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of summer, fourth month, wuchen, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Summer opened on wuchen with another eclipse.

sentences.zh: 五月，旱。

translations.literal: In the fifth month there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: May was rainless.

sentences.zh: 以太保何曾領司徒。

translations.literal: Grand protector He Zeng was additionally appointed steward of the masters of the people.
translations.idiomatic: He Zeng added the stewardship of the masters of the people to his grand protector’s hat.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，東海王祗薨。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei of the sixth month king Zhi of Donghai died.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yiwei: the king of Donghai, Zhi, died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of autumn, seventh month, dingyou, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn began on dingyou with yet another eclipse.

sentences.zh: 吳將魯淑圍弋陽，征虜將軍王渾擊敗之。

translations.literal: Wu general Lu Shu besieged Yiyang; Wang Hun, general who subdues captives, defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shu of Wu surrounded Yiyang until Wang Hun broke the siege.

sentences.zh: 罷五官左右中郎將、弘訓太僕、衛尉、大長秋等官。

translations.literal: The posts of senior and junior generals of the gentlemen of the five departments, grand coachman of Hongxun, commandant of the guards, and grand prolonger of autumn were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: A bundle of sinecures—five-department generals, Hongxun coachman, commandant of guards, grand prolonger of autumn—was cut.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑寇廣寧，殺略五千人。

translations.literal: The Xianbei raided Guangning, killing and carrying off about five thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: Xianbei horsemen sacked Guangning and took five thousand lives or captives.

sentences.zh: 詔聘公卿以下子女以備六宮，采擇未畢，權禁斷婚姻。

translations.literal: An edict ordered recruitment of sons and daughters of dukes and ministers downward to fill the six palaces; until the selection was finished, marriages were temporarily forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The court began drafting noble youths for the harem and froze all weddings until the levy ended.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，制女年十七父母不嫁者，使長吏配之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day xinsi, it was decreed that if a girl of seventeen had not been married by her parents, the chief should assign her a husband.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, xinsi: any unmarried girl of seventeen would be paired off by the magistrate.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，臨宣武觀大閱諸軍，甲辰乃罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou of the eleventh month he attended the Xuanwu review stand to inspect the armies in grand review; on jiachen it ended.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingyou: he watched a full army parade at Xuanwu Gate until jiachen.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月辛亥，帝耕于藉田。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on the day xinhai, the emperor ploughed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year, spring, xinhai: another ploughing rite.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸酉，太傅、壽光公鄭沖薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day guiyou, Zheng Chong, grand tutor and duke of Shouguang, died.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary guiyou: grand tutor Zheng Chong died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，高陽王珪薨。

translations.literal: On the day jimao king Gui of Gaoyang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Sima Gui of Gaoyang died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太原王瑰薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen king Gui of Taiyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Sima Gui of Taiyuan died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「嫡庶之別，所以辨上下，明貴賤。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai an edict said: “The distinction between legitimate wife and concubine’s sons is how one distinguishes high from low and clarifies noble from base.”
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he issued a long edict on the difference between main-line and secondary sons, meant to fix rank and ritual.

sentences.zh: 而近世以來，多皆內寵，登妃后之職，亂尊卑之序。

translations.literal: Yet in recent generations many have been inner favorites who ascended to the posts of consort and empress, disordering the sequence of honored and humble.
translations.idiomatic: In recent reigns, however, palace favorites had climbed to empress and thrown the proper order of rank into confusion.

sentences.zh: 自今以後，皆不得登用妾媵以爲嫡正。」

translations.literal: From this time onward none may promote a concubine or handmaid to be legitimate principal wife."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth no concubine may be elevated to the rank of principal consort."

sentences.zh: 二月，分幽州五郡置平州。

translations.literal: In the second month five commanderies of Youzhou were split off to establish Ping province.
translations.idiomatic: February saw Ping province carved from five Youzhou counties.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the day guihai of the third month there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guihai: a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，太尉、臨淮公荀顗薨。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jiwei, Xun Yi, grand commandant and duke of Linhuai, died.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, jiwei: Xun Yi, grand commandant of Linhuai, died.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，臨聽訟觀錄囚徒，多所原遣。

translations.literal: On the day guisi of the sixth month he attended the hall for hearing lawsuits, reviewed prisoners, and many were pardoned or released.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guisi: another prison review freed many inmates.

sentences.zh: 是夏，大蝗。

translations.literal: That summer there were great locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts swarmed that summer.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅，皇后楊氏崩。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day bingyin, Empress Yang died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingyin: Empress Yang passed away.

sentences.zh: 壬午，吳平虜將孟泰、偏將軍王嗣等帥眾降。

translations.literal: On the day renwu Wu’s general who pacifies captives Meng Tai, deputy general Wang Si, and others led their troops to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Renwu: Wu officers Meng Tai and Wang Si brought their men over to Jin.

sentences.zh: 八月，涼州虜寇金城諸郡，鎮西將軍、汝陰王駿討之，斬其帥乞文泥等。

translations.literal: In the eighth month tribesmen of Liang province raided the commanderies around Jincheng; Sima Jun, great general who guards the west and king of Ru'yin, campaigned against them and beheaded their leaders Qi Wenni and others.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Liang tribes raided Jincheng until Sima Jun cut down chiefs such as Qi Wenni.

sentences.zh: 戊申，葬元皇后于峻陽陵。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Empress Yuan was buried at Junyang mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the late empress was laid to rest at Junyang.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，以大將軍陳騫爲太尉。

translations.literal: On the day guihai of the ninth month great general Chen Qian was appointed grand commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guihai: Chen Qian became grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 攻拔吳枳里城，獲吳立信校尉莊祐。

translations.literal: They stormed and took Wu’s fortress town Zhili and captured Wu’s established-trustworthiness colonel Zhuang You.
translations.idiomatic: Jin troops seized Zhili and took colonel Zhuang You prisoner.

sentences.zh: 吳將孫遵、李承帥眾寇江夏，太守嵇喜擊破之。

translations.literal: Wu generals Sun Zun and Li Cheng led a host to raid Jiangxi; prefect Ji Xi defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Zun and Li Cheng struck Jiangxia but Ji Xi drove them off.

sentences.zh: 立河橋于富平津。

translations.literal: They built a river bridge at Fuping ford.
translations.idiomatic: A bridge was thrown across the Yellow River at Fuping ford.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，立城東七里澗石橋。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month they erected a stone bridge over the seven-li gully east of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Winter: a stone span was built east of Luoyang over the Seven-li Ditch.

sentences.zh: 庚午，帝臨宣武觀，大閱諸軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu the emperor attended the Xuanwu review stand and held a grand review of the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he reviewed the hosts at Xuanwu Gate.

sentences.zh: 十二月，有星孛于軫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month a broom star appeared in the asterism Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: December: a comet trailed through Zhen.

sentences.zh: 置藉田令。

translations.literal: They established the office of director of the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: A superintendent of the ritual plough-lands was added to the roster.

sentences.zh: 立太原王子緝爲高陽王。

translations.literal: He established Ji, son of the king of Taiyuan, as king of Gaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiyuan king’s son Ji was promoted to king of Gaoyang.

sentences.zh: 吳威北將軍嚴聰、揚威將軍嚴整、偏將軍朱買來降。

translations.literal: Wu’s general who awes the north Yan Cong, general who raises might Yan Zheng, and deputy general Zhu Mai came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Wu’s northern commanders Yan Cong, Yan Zheng, and Zhu Mai defected with their units.

sentences.zh: 是歲，鑿陝南山，決河，東注洛，以通運漕。

translations.literal: That year they cut through the southern Shaan range, breached the river, and sent it eastward into the Luo to open transport by water.
translations.idiomatic: Engineers cut a channel through southern Shanxi to swing the river east into the Luo and ease grain barges.

sentences.zh: 咸寧元年春正月戊午朔，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianning, spring, first month, on the first day wuwu, there was a great amnesty and the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Xianning opened on wuwu with amnesty and a new era name.

sentences.zh: 二月，以將士應已娶者多，家有五女者給復。

translations.literal: In the second month, because many officers and soldiers due for enrollment were already married, households that had five daughters were granted exemption from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: February brought relief for families swamped with daughters: any household raising five girls was excused from labor levies, so married soldiers could still serve without ruining their kin.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，[14]以故鄴令夏謖有清稱，賜穀百斛。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou [14], because former Ye magistrate Xia Mo enjoyed a reputation for purity, he was granted one hundred hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Xinyou [14]: Xia Mo, once magistrate of Ye, received a hundred hu for his clean name.

sentences.zh: 以奉祿薄，賜公卿以下帛有差。

translations.literal: Because stipends were thin, silks were bestowed on the dukes and ministers downward, each according to difference.
translations.idiomatic: Slender salaries were padded with graded silk gifts to the bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 叛虜樹機能送質請降。

translations.literal: The mutinous tribesman Shujineng sent hostages and asked to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Di rebel Shujineng offered hostages and sued for peace.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，下邳、廣陵大風，拔木，壞廬舍。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, great winds at Xiapi and Guangling uprooted trees and ruined huts.
translations.idiomatic: Summer: gales on the Huai coast tore up trees and flattened cottages.

sentences.zh: 六月，鮮卑力微遣子來獻。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Xianbei chief Liwei sent his son to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Xianbei chief Liwei’s son arrived with gifts.

sentences.zh: 吳人寇江夏。

translations.literal: Wu men raided Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: Wu raiders hit Jiangxia again.

sentences.zh: 西域戊己校尉馬循討叛鮮卑，破之，斬其渠帥。

translations.literal: Ma Xun, Wu-ji colonel of the Western Regions, campaigned against mutinous Xianbei, defeated them, and beheaded their chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Western Regions colonel Ma Xun crushed rebel Xianbei and took their chief’s head.

sentences.zh: 戊申，置太子詹事官。

translations.literal: On the day wushen the office of superintendent of the heir apparent’s household was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the crown prince gained a full household administration.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the last day of the seventh month, jiashen, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Month’s end, jiashen: eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 郡國螟。

translations.literal: The commanderies and principalities suffered from grain-eating caterpillars.
translations.idiomatic: Crop-worms blighted fields across the provinces.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，青州螟，徐州大水。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi of the ninth month Qing province had caterpillars and Xu province great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiazi: worms in Qing, floods in Xu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，常山王殷薨。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou of the tenth month king Yin of Changshan died.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yiyou: Sima Yin of Changshan died.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，彭城王權薨。

translations.literal: On the day guisi king Quan of Pengcheng died.
translations.idiomatic: Guisi: the Pengcheng king Sima Quan died.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，大閱於宣武觀，至于己巳。

translations.literal: On the day guihai of the eleventh month a grand review was held at the Xuanwu stand until jisi.
translations.idiomatic: Guihai to jisi: another full-dress parade at Xuanwu.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，追尊宣帝廟曰高祖，景帝曰世宗，文帝曰太祖。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai of the twelfth month posthumous temple names were raised: emperor Xuan as Gaozu, emperor Jing as Shizong, emperor Wen as Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: Dinghai: Xuan, Jing, and Wen received temple names Gaozu, Shizong, and Taizu.

sentences.zh: 是月大疫，洛陽死者太半。

translations.literal: That month a great pestilence struck; more than half died in Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: A plague carried off over half of Luoyang that month.

sentences.zh: 封裴頠爲鉅鹿公。

translations.literal: Pei Wei was enfeoffed as duke of Julu.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Wei received the Julu ducal title.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，以疾疫廢朝。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, court was suspended because of pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: Xianning 2 opened with plague so severe that regular court was canceled.

sentences.zh: 賜諸散吏至于士卒絲各有差。

translations.literal: Silks were bestowed on all clerks in miscellaneous service down to common soldiers, each according to difference.
translations.idiomatic: Even petty clerks and rank-and-file troops received graded silk handouts.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，河間王洪薨。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu of the second month king Hong of Hejian died.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingxu: Sima Hong of Hejian died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，赦五歲刑以下。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu he pardoned penal labor up to five years.
translations.idiomatic: Jiawu: sentences of five years or less were remitted.

sentences.zh: 東夷八國歸化。

translations.literal: Eight states of the eastern Yi came to submit and accept imperial rule.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Yi polities along the eastern seaboard asked to enter the map as Jin subjects.

sentences.zh: 并州虜犯塞，監并州諸軍事胡奮擊破之。

translations.literal: Tribesmen of Bing province violated the frontier; Hu Fen, supervisor of all military affairs of Bing, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Bing tribes raided the wall; Hu Fen, Bing’s military supervisor, beat them back.

sentences.zh: 初，燉煌太守尹璩卒，州以燉煌令梁澄領太守事，議郎令狐豐廢澄，自領郡事。

translations.literal: At first, when Dunhuang prefect Yin Qu died, the province had ordered Dunhuang magistrate Liang Cheng to act as prefect; gentleman in discussion Linghu Feng removed Cheng and himself took charge of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Dunhuang had fallen into chaos after Yin Qu’s death: Linghu Feng ousted acting magistrate Liang Cheng and seized the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 豐死，弟宏代之。

translations.literal: When Feng died, his younger brother Hong replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: When Linghu Feng died, his brother Hong continued the usurpation.

sentences.zh: 至是，涼州刺史楊欣斬宏，傳首洛陽。

translations.literal: At this point Yang Xin, inspector of Liang province, executed Hong and sent the head to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Now Yang Xin, Liang’s inspector, beheaded Hong and shipped the head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 先是，帝不豫，及瘳，群臣上壽。

translations.literal: Before this the emperor had been indisposed; when he recovered, the host of ministers offered congratulations on his longevity.
translations.idiomatic: After his illness lifted, the court wanted to celebrate his recovery with formal toasts.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「每念頃遇疫氣死亡，爲之愴然。

translations.literal: An edict said: “Whenever I think how lately the pestilence carried off so many dead, my heart is stricken.”
translations.idiomatic: He refused: “Each time I remember the plague’s toll, grief stops my breath.”

sentences.zh: 豈以一身之休息，忘百姓之艱邪？

translations.literal: How could I, for the ease of one body, forget the hardship of the hundred surnames?
translations.idiomatic: How could I indulge my own comfort while the people still mourn?”

sentences.zh: 諸上禮者皆絕之。」

translations.literal: All who would present congratulatory rites are to desist.”
translations.idiomatic: Cancel every proposal for congratulatory banquets.”

sentences.zh: 夏五月，鎮西大將軍、汝陰王駿討北胡，斬其渠帥吐敦。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Sima Jun, great general who guards the west and king of Ru'yin, campaigned against the northern Hu and beheaded their chieftain Tudun.
translations.idiomatic: Summer: Sima Jun struck northern tribes and killed their chief Tudun.

sentences.zh: 立國子學。

translations.literal: The national university was established.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial university opened its doors.

sentences.zh: 庚午，大雩。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu he held the great rain prayer.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，薦荔支于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day guichou of the sixth month lychees were offered in the grand temple.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guichou: fresh lychees went onto the ancestral altar.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，[15]有星孛于氐。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu [15] a broom star appeared in the asterism Di.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxu [15]: a comet shone in Di.

sentences.zh: 自春旱，至于是月始雨。

translations.literal: From spring there had been drought; only in this month did rain begin.
translations.idiomatic: The long spring drought broke at last in the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 吳京下督孫楷帥眾來降，以爲車騎將軍，封丹楊侯。

translations.literal: Sun Kai, Wu’s commander below the capital, led his host to surrender; he was appointed general of chariots and cavalry and enfeoffed as marquis of Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Kai, Wu’s capital-area commander, defected and became chariots-and-cavalry general, marquis of Danyang.

sentences.zh: 白龍二見于新興井中。

translations.literal: Two white dragons were seen in a well at Xinxing.
translations.idiomatic: Two white dragons were reported in a Xinxing village well.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，有星孛于大角。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, a broom star appeared at Dajiao.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: a comet hung at the bright star Arcturus.

sentences.zh: 吳臨平湖自漢末壅塞，至是自開。

translations.literal: Wu’s Linping Lake, blocked since late Han, opened of itself at this time.
translations.idiomatic: Linping Lake in Wu, silted since Han’s end, suddenly cleared.

sentences.zh: 父老相傳云：「此湖塞，天下亂；

translations.literal: The elders handed down a saying: “When this lake is blocked, the realm is in chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Local graybeards said, “When Linping dams up, the empire totters.

sentences.zh: 此湖開，天下平」癸丑，安平王隆薨。

translations.literal: When this lake opens, the realm is at peace.” On the day guichou king Long of Anping died.
translations.idiomatic: When it opens again, peace returns.” On guichou Sima Long of Anping died.

sentences.zh: 東夷十七國內附。

translations.literal: Seventeen states of the eastern Yi submitted within the borders.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen Yi realms asked for annexation.

sentences.zh: 河南、魏郡暴水，殺百餘人，詔給棺。

translations.literal: Henan and Wei commandery suffered violent floods that killed more than a hundred persons; an edict ordered coffins supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Cloudbursts in Henan and Wei drowned over a hundred; the court paid for coffins.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑阿羅多等寇邊，西域戊己校尉馬循討之，斬首四千餘級，獲生九千餘人，於是來降。

translations.literal: The Xianbei Arluoduo and others raided the frontier; Ma Xun, Wu-ji colonel of the Western Regions, campaigned against them, beheading more than four thousand grades and capturing more than nine thousand alive; thereupon they came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Xianbei chief Arluoduo raided the line until Ma Xun killed four thousand and took nine thousand prisoners, after which they yielded.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，河東、平陽地震。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengchen, Hedong and Pingyang suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengchen: Hedong and Pingyang shook.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以太保何曾爲太傅，太尉陳騫爲大司馬，司空賈充爲太尉，鎮軍大將軍齊王攸爲司空。

translations.literal: On the day jihai He Zeng, grand protector, was made grand tutor; Chen Qian, grand commandant, grand marshal; Jia Chong, minister of works, grand commandant; Sima You, great general who guards the army and king of Qi, minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Jihai reshuffled the summit: He Zeng to grand tutor, Chen Qian to grand marshal, Jia Chong to grand commandant, Sima You to minister of works.

sentences.zh: 有星孛于太微，九月又孛于翼。

translations.literal: In the eighth month a broom star appeared in Supreme Palace Enclosure; in the ninth month another appeared in Yi.
translations.idiomatic: A comet crossed the “Supreme Palace” asterism in the eighth month; a second brushed the Wings mansion in the ninth.

sentences.zh: 丁未，起太倉於城東，常平倉於東西市。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei they raised a grand granary east of the city and ever-normal granaries in the eastern and western markets.
translations.idiomatic: Dingwei: a state granary rose east of Luoyang, with “ever-normal” bins in both market wards.

translations.literal: Editorial note sixteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: The recension marks commentary note sixteen here.

sentences.zh: 閏月，荊州五郡水，流四千餘家。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month five commanderies of Jing province flooded, sweeping away more than four thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month: Jing floods displaced over four thousand families.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，以汝陰王駿爲征西大將軍，平南將軍羊祜爲征南大將軍。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Sima Jun, king of Ru'yin, was made great general who campaigns west, and Yang Hu, general who pacifies the south, great general who campaigns south.
translations.idiomatic: Winter: Sima Jun became western expedition commander, Yang Hu southern expedition commander.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，立皇后楊氏，大赦，賜王公以下及于鰥寡各有差。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao he established lady Yang as empress, declared a great amnesty, and bestowed gifts on the kings and dukes downward to widowers and widows, each according to difference.
translations.idiomatic: Dingmao: a new empress Yang, general amnesty, and graded gifts from princes down to the destitute.

sentences.zh: 十一月，白龍二見于梁國。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month two white dragons were seen in the principality of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: November: twin white dragons in Liang.

sentences.zh: 十二月，徵處士安定皇甫謐爲太子中庶子，封后父鎮軍將軍楊駿爲臨晉侯。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the recluse Huangfu Mi of Anding was summoned as palace attendant to the heir apparent, and the empress’s father, Yang Jun, general who guards the army, was enfeoffed as marquis of Linjin.
translations.idiomatic: December called scholar Huangfu Mi to tutor the heir and made empress Yang’s father Yang Jun marquis of Linjin.

sentences.zh: 是月，以平州刺史傅詢、前廣平太守孟桓清白有聞，詢賜帛二百匹，桓百匹。

translations.literal: That month, because Pingzhou inspector Fu Xun and former Guangping prefect Meng Huan were reputed incorrupt, Xun was granted two hundred bolts of silk and Huan one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The same month rewarded honest officials—two hundred rolls for Fu Xun, one hundred for Meng Huan.

sentences.zh: 三月，平虜護軍文淑討叛虜樹機能等，[17]並破之。

translations.literal: In the third month Wen Shu, protector general who pacifies captives, campaigned against the mutinous tribesman Shujineng and others [17], and defeated them all.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Wen Shu broke Shujineng’s Di confederation [17].

sentences.zh: 有星孛于胃。

translations.literal: A broom star appeared in the asterism Wei.
translations.idiomatic: A comet trailed through the Wei mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙未，帝將射雉，慮損麥苗而止。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei the emperor was about to shoot pheasants but stopped, fearing damage to the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: Yiwei: he canceled a hunt lest arrows trample the wheat.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊子，吳將邵凱、夏祥帥眾七千餘人來降。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on the day wuzi, Wu generals Shao Kai and Xia Xiang led more than seven thousand men to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, wuzi: Shao Kai and Xia Xiang brought seven thousand Wu soldiers over.

translations.literal: Editorial note eighteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: The recension marks commentary note eighteen here.

sentences.zh: 六月，益、梁八郡水，殺三百餘人，沒邸閣別倉。

translations.literal: In the sixth month eight commanderies of Yi and Liang suffered floods that killed more than three hundred persons and submerged lodge granaries outside the main depots.
translations.idiomatic: June: flash floods in Yi and Liang drowned three hundred and swamped auxiliary granaries.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以都督豫州諸軍事王渾爲都督揚州諸軍事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Wang Hun, supervisor of all military affairs of Yu province, was appointed supervisor of all military affairs of Yang province.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Wang Hun moved from Yu to overall command on the Yang front.

sentences.zh: 中山王睦以罪廢爲丹水侯。

translations.literal: King Mu of Zhongshan was stripped of rank for a crime and made marquis of Danshui.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Mu of Zhongshan lost his kingship for misconduct and became marquis of Danshui.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，徙扶風王亮爲汝南王，東莞王伷爲琅邪王，汝陰王駿爲扶風王，琅邪王倫爲趙王，渤海王輔爲太原王，太原王顒爲河間王，北海王陵爲任城王，陳王斌爲西河王，汝南王柬爲南陽王，濟南王耽爲中山王，河間王威爲章武王。

translations.literal: On the day guihai of the eighth month king Liang of Fufeng was transferred to king of Runan, king Zhou of Dongguan to king of Langye, king Jun of Ru'yin to king of Fufeng, king Lun of Langye to king of Zhao, king Fu of Bohai to king of Taiyuan, king Yong of Taiyuan to king of Hejian, king Ling of Beihai to king of Rencheng, king Bin of Chen to king of Xihe, king Jian of Runan to king of Nanyang, king Dan of Jinan to king of Zhongshan, king Wei of Hejian to king of Zhangwu.
translations.idiomatic: Guihai: a wholesale rotation of princely fiefs—Liang to Runan, Zhou to Langye, Jun to Fufeng, Lun to Zhao, and so through the royal cousins.

sentences.zh: 立皇子瑋爲始平王，允爲濮陽王，該爲新都王，遐爲清河王，鉅平侯羊祜爲南城侯。

translations.literal: He established the imperial son Wei as king of Shiping, Yun as king of Puyang, Gai as king of Xindu, Xia as king of Qinghe, and marquis Yang Hu of Juling as marquis of Nancheng.
translations.idiomatic: New princely lines were drawn for Wei, Yun, Gai, and Xia, while Yang Hu traded Juling for Nancheng marquisate.

sentences.zh: 以汝南王亮爲鎮南大將軍。

translations.literal: King Liang of Runan was appointed great general who guards the south.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Liang of Runan took southern command.

sentences.zh: 大風拔樹，暴寒且冰，[19]郡國五隕霜，傷穀。

translations.literal: Great winds uprooted trees; violent cold brought ice [19]; five commanderies reported killing frost that injured the grain.
translations.idiomatic: Gales, sudden frost, and ice [19] damaged crops in five provinces.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，以左將軍胡奮爲都督江北諸軍事。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi of the ninth month Hu Fen, general of the left, was appointed supervisor of all military affairs north of the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuzi: Hu Fen took charge north of the great river.

sentences.zh: 兗、豫、徐、青、荊、益、梁七州大水，傷秋稼，詔振給之。

translations.literal: The seven provinces Yan, Yu, Xu, Qing, Jing, Yi, and Liang suffered great floods that injured the autumn harvest; an edict ordered relief.
translations.idiomatic: Seven provinces flooded at once, ruining the autumn crop; grain relief followed.

sentences.zh: 立齊王子蕤爲遼東王，贊爲廣漢王。

translations.literal: He established Rui and Zan, sons of the king of Qi, as kings of Liaodong and Guanghan respectively.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi king’s sons Rui and Zan became princes of Liaodong and Guanghan.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丙戌，帝臨宣武觀大閱，至于壬辰。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu of winter, the eleventh month, the emperor attended the Xuanwu stand for a grand review until renchen.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, bingxu to renchen: another army parade at Xuanwu.

sentences.zh: 十二月，吳將孫慎入江夏、汝南，略千餘家而去。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Wu general Sun Shen entered Jiangxia and Runan, carried off more than a thousand households, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: December: Sun Shen raided Jiangxia and Runan, dragging off a thousand families.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西北雜虜及鮮卑、匈奴、五溪蠻夷、東夷三國前後十餘輩，[20]各帥種人部落內附。

translations.literal: That year more than ten parties of northwestern miscellaneous tribes, Xianbei, Xiongnu, Wuxi Man-yi, and three eastern Yi states [20], each leading their clans and tribes, submitted within the borders.
translations.idiomatic: Year’s end saw a wave of defections—steppe tribes, Xianbei, Xiongnu, Wuxi peoples, and three Yi realms [20]—each chief bringing his people in.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月庚午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the first day gengwu, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, new moon on gengwu: eclipse.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，尚書左僕射盧欽卒。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen of the third month Lu Qin, senior vice-director of the masters of the left, died.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiashen: Lu Qin died in office.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以尚書右僕射山濤爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Shan Tao, senior vice-director of the masters of the right, was appointed senior vice-director of the masters of the left.
translations.idiomatic: Xinyou: Shan Tao moved from right to left vice-president of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: [21]東夷六國來獻。

translations.literal: [21] Six states of the eastern Yi came to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: [21] Six Yi realms along the coast sent tribute embassies.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，蚩尤旗見於東井。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the “Chiyou banner” comet appeared in the Eastern Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Summer: a long-tailed “Chiyou” comet blazed above the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，陰平、廣武地震，甲子又震。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei of the sixth month there were earthquakes at Yinping and Guangwu; on jiazi there were earthquakes again.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingwei: Yinping and Guangwu shook; aftershocks hit on jiazi.

sentences.zh: 涼州刺史楊欣與虜若羅拔能等戰于武威，敗績，死之。

translations.literal: Yang Xin, inspector of Liang province, fought the tribesmen Ruluobaneng and others at Wuwei, was routed, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Liang inspector Yang Xin died in defeat at Wuwei fighting the Ruluobaneng confederation.

sentences.zh: 弘訓皇后羊氏崩。

translations.literal: Empress Yang of the Hongxun palace died.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Yang, dowager empress of the Hongxun palace, passed away.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，祔葬景獻皇后羊氏于峻平陵。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day jichou, Empress Jingxian, lady Yang, was given joint burial at Junping mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jichou: Empress Jingxian was laid beside her husband at Junping tomb.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，高陽王緝薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin king Ji of Gaoyang died.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyin: Sima Ji of Gaoyang died.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，范陽王綏薨。

translations.literal: On the day guisi king Sui of Fanyang died.
translations.idiomatic: Guisi: Sima Sui of Fanyang died.

sentences.zh: 荊、揚郡國二十皆大水。

translations.literal: Twenty commanderies and principalities of Jing and Yang suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty Jing and Yang jurisdictions were underwater.

sentences.zh: 九月，以太傅何曾爲太宰。

translations.literal: In the ninth month He Zeng, grand tutor, was appointed grand preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: September: He Zeng rose from grand tutor to grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以尚書令李胤爲司徒。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi Li Yin, supervisor of the masters of writing, was appointed steward of the masters of the people.
translations.idiomatic: Xinsi: Li Yin became steward of the masters of the people.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，以征北大將軍衛瓘爲尚書令。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month Wei Guan, great general who campaigns north, was appointed supervisor of the masters of writing.
translations.idiomatic: Winter: northern commander Wei Guan took over the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 揚州刺史應綽伐吳皖城，斬首五千級，焚穀米百八十萬斛。

translations.literal: Ying Chuo, inspector of Yang province, attacked Wu’s fortress at Wan, took five thousand heads, and burned one million eight hundred thousand hu of grain and rice.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Chuo stormed Wu’s Wan stronghold, counted five thousand kills, and torched nearly two million hu of enemy stores.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，太醫司馬程據獻雉頭裘，帝以奇技異服典禮所禁，焚之於殿前。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi of the eleventh month Cheng Ju, court physician, presented a pheasant-head fur robe; the emperor, because strange skills and exotic garments are forbidden by ritual canon, burned it before the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Xinsi: a court doctor offered a pheasant-skin cloak; the emperor burned it as illegal luxury.

sentences.zh: 甲申，敕內外敢有犯者罪之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen he ordered that inside and outside any who dared violate the rule be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Jiashen: a decree threatened punishment for anyone peddling such finery.

sentences.zh: 吳昭武將軍劉翻、厲武將軍祖始來降。

translations.literal: Wu’s general who displays martial power Liu Fan and general who displays stern martial power Zu Shi came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Wu generals Liu Fan and Zu Shi crossed with their commands.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以尚書杜預都督荊州諸軍事。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao Du Yu of the masters of writing was appointed supervisor of all military affairs of Jing province.
translations.idiomatic: Xinmao: Du Yu took supreme command on the Jing front.

sentences.zh: 征南大將軍羊祜卒。

translations.literal: Yang Hu, great general who campaigns south, died.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Hu, the southern expedition commander, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，西河王斌薨。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei of the twelfth month king Bin of Xihe died.
translations.idiomatic: Yiwei: Sima Bin of Xihe died.

sentences.zh: 丁未，太宰朗陵公何曾薨。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei He Zeng, grand preceptor and duke of Langling, died.
translations.idiomatic: Dingwei: He Zeng, grand preceptor, died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，東夷九國內附。

translations.literal: That year nine states of the eastern Yi submitted within the borders.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Yi polities entered Jin’s orbit that year.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月，虜帥樹機能攻陷涼州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, the tribesman chief Shujineng captured Liang province.
translations.idiomatic: Xianning 5 opened with Shujineng’s Di army seizing Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，使討虜護軍武威太守馬隆擊之。

translations.literal: On the day yichou he ordered Ma Long, protector general who smites captives and prefect of Wuwei, to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Yichou: Ma Long of Wuwei was sent to retake the northwest.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，白麟見于平原。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu of the second month a white unicorn was seen in Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiawu: a white kirin was sighted in Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 三月，匈奴都督拔弈虛帥部落歸化。

translations.literal: In the third month the Xiongnu superintendent Bayixu led his tribe to submit and be civilized.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Xiongnu chief Bayixu brought his people in.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以百姓饑饉，減御膳之半。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, because the hundred surnames suffered famine, half of the imperial kitchen’s meals was cut.
translations.idiomatic: Yihai: famine in the realm halved the palace table.

sentences.zh: 有星孛于柳。

translations.literal: A broom star appeared in the asterism Liu.
translations.idiomatic: A comet trailed through the Willow mansion.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，又孛于女御。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, another appeared in Nüyu.
translations.idiomatic: Summer: a second comet shone in the Nüyu asterism.

sentences.zh: 大赦，降除部曲督以下質任。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was declared and hostage requirements were lowered or removed for supervisors of private troops downward.
translations.idiomatic: Amnesty followed, and hostage rules were eased for hereditary officers down to company level.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，郡國八雨雹，[22]傷秋稼，壞百姓廬舍。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai eight commanderies and principalities were struck by hail [22], injuring the autumn crop and ruining commoners’ huts.
translations.idiomatic: Dinghai: hailstorms in eight provinces [22] smashed the harvest and flattened homes.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，有星孛于紫宮。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, a broom star appeared in the Purple Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: another comet circled the pole stars.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，麟見于河南。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu of the ninth month a unicorn was seen south of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiawu: a kirin appeared in Henan commandery.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，匈奴餘渠都督獨雍等帥部落歸化。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day wuyin, Xiongnu superintendent Duyong of the Yüqu channel and others led their tribes to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuyin: more Xiongnu bands under Duyong surrendered.

sentences.zh: 汲郡人不準掘魏襄王冢，[23]得竹簡小篆古書十餘萬言，藏于祕府。

translations.literal: A man of Ji commandery named Bu Zhun dug open the tomb of Wei king Xiang of Wei [23] and obtained more than a hundred thousand words of ancient bamboo documents in small-seal script, which were stored in the secret treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Zhun of Ji opened King Xiang’s Wei tomb [23] and pulled up a huge cache of Warring States bamboo slips for the imperial library.

sentences.zh: 十一月，大舉伐吳，遣鎮軍將軍、琅邪王伷出涂中，[24]安東將軍王渾出江西，建威將軍王戎出武昌，平南將軍胡奮出夏口，鎮南大將軍杜預出江陵，龍驤將軍王濬、廣武將軍唐彬率巴蜀之卒浮江而下，東西凡二十餘萬。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month a great campaign was launched against Wu: Sima Zhou, general who guards the army and king of Langye, went out from Tu; Wang Hun, general who guards the east, from west of the river; Wang Rong, general who displays might, from Wuchang; Hu Fen, general who pacifies the south, from Xiakou; Du Yu, great general who guards the south, from Jiangling; Wang Jun, general who displays dragon prowess, and Tang Bin, general who displays martial breadth, led Ba–Shu troops down the Yangzi—more than two hundred thousand men on the eastern and western axes combined [24].
translations.idiomatic: November: the conquest of Wu opened on every vector—Sima Zhou from Tu, Wang Hun from the north bank, Wang Rong, Hu Fen, Du Yu, and a river fleet under Wang Jun and Tang Bin—over two hundred thousand soldiers [24].

sentences.zh: 以太尉賈充爲大都督，行冠軍將軍楊濟爲副，總統眾軍。

translations.literal: Grand commandant Jia Chong was made supreme commander, with acting general who displays champion prowess Yang Ji as deputy, commanding all hosts.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Chong took supreme command with Yang Ji as his second.

sentences.zh: 十二月，馬隆擊叛虜樹機能，大破，斬之，涼州平。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Ma Long struck the mutinous tribesman Shujineng, crushed him utterly, beheaded him, and Liang province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: December: Ma Long killed Shujineng and recovered Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 肅慎來獻楛矢石砮。

translations.literal: The Sushen people came to present mulberry-wood arrows and stone arrowheads.
translations.idiomatic: Sushen foresters sent their classic stone-tipped arrows as tribute.

sentences.zh: 太康元年春正月己丑朔，五色氣冠日。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taikang, spring, first month, on the first day jichou, five-colored vapors crowned the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Taikang opened on jichou with a five-hued halo around the sun.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，王渾克吳尋陽賴鄉諸城，獲吳武威將軍周興。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Wang Hun took Wu’s towns around Xunyang and Lai township, capturing Wu’s general who displays martial might Zhou Xing.
translations.idiomatic: Guichou: Wang Hun cleared the Xunyang sector and captured Zhou Xing.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，王濬、唐彬等克丹楊城。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu of the second month Wang Jun, Tang Bin, and others took Danyang city.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuwu: the river fleet seized Danyang.

sentences.zh: 庚申，又克西陵，殺西陵都督、鎮軍將軍留憲，[25]征南將軍成璩，西陵監鄭廣。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen they also took Xiling, killing Xiling commander and general who guards the army Liu Xian [25], general who campaigns south Cheng Quan, and Xiling intendant Zheng Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Gengshen: Xiling fell; Liu Xian, Cheng Quan, and Zheng Guang died defending it [25].

sentences.zh: 壬戌，濬又克夷道樂鄉城，殺夷道監陸晏、水軍都督陸景。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Jun further took Yidao and Lexiang towns, killing Yidao intendant Lu Yan and commander of the navy Lu Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Renxu: Wang Jun pushed to Yidao and Lexiang and killed Lu Yan and Lu Jing.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，杜預克江陵，斬吳江陵督伍延；

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu Du Yu took Jiangling and beheaded Wu’s Jiangling commander Wu Yan;
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxu: Du Yu entered Jiangling and executed Wu Yan;

sentences.zh: [26]平南將軍胡奮克江安。

translations.literal: [26] General who pacifies the south Hu Fen took Jiang’an.
translations.idiomatic: [26] Hu Fen secured Jiang’an.

sentences.zh: 於是諸軍並進，樂鄉、荊門諸戍相次來降。

translations.literal: Thereupon all armies advanced together, and the garrisons at Lexiang, Jingmen, and others surrendered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Fort after fort—Lexiang, Jingmen—raised white flags.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以濬爲都督益、梁二州諸軍事，復下詔曰：「濬、彬東下，掃除巴丘，與胡奮、王戎共平夏口、武昌，順流長騖，直造秣陵，與奮、戎審量其宜。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Wang Jun was appointed supervisor of all military affairs of Yi and Liang provinces, and an edict further said: “When Jun and Bin sail east, clear Baqiu, join Hu Fen and Wang Rong to pacify Xiakou and Wuchang, then drive straight down the stream to Moling with Fen and Rong coordinating as fits.”
translations.idiomatic: Yihai: Wang Jun received two-province command while orders told him to sweep the middle Yangzi and meet allies before Moling.

sentences.zh: 杜預當鎮靜零、桂，懷輯衡陽。

translations.literal: Du Yu shall keep calm over Ling and Gui and soothe Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Du Yu was to hold the southern Jing pocket and win over Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 大兵既過，荊州南境固當傳檄而定，預當分萬人給濬，七千給彬。

translations.literal: Once the great army has passed, the southern marches of Jing ought to be settled by proclamation alone; Yu shall detach ten thousand men to Jun and seven thousand to Bin.
translations.idiomatic: After the main thrust, Du Yu was to feed ten thousand troops to Wang Jun and seven thousand to Tang Bin.

sentences.zh: 夏口既平，奮宜以七千人給濬。

translations.literal: Once Xiakou is pacified, Fen should give seven thousand men to Jun.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiakou fell, Hu Fen was to shift seven thousand soldiers to Wang Jun.

sentences.zh: 武昌既了，戎當以六千人增彬。

translations.literal: Once Wuchang is settled, Rong should add six thousand men to Bin.
translations.idiomatic: After Wuchang, Wang Rong was to reinforce Tang Bin with six thousand.

sentences.zh: 太尉充移屯項，總督諸方。

translations.literal: Grand commandant Chong shall shift his camp to Xiang and oversee every front.”
translations.idiomatic: Jia Chong would move headquarters to Xiang and coordinate all theaters.”

sentences.zh: 」濬進破夏口、武昌，遂泛舟東下，所至皆平。

translations.literal: Jun advanced, broke Xiakou and Wuchang, then sailed east; wherever he went it was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun smashed the river defenses and swept downstream unopposed.

sentences.zh: 王渾、周浚與吳丞相張悌戰于版橋，大破之，斬悌及其將孫震、沈瑩，傳首洛陽。

translations.literal: Wang Hun, Zhou Jun, and Wu chancellor Zhang Ti fought at Banqiao; they crushed him, beheaded Ti and his generals Sun Zhen and Shen Ying, and sent the heads to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: At Banqiao Wang Hun and Zhou Jun killed Zhang Ti and his lieutenants and shipped the heads north.

sentences.zh: 孫皓窮蹙請降，送璽綬於琅邪王伷。

translations.literal: Sun Hao, driven to extremity, asked to surrender and sent the seal and cord to king Zhou of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Hao capitulated, handing the imperial seal to Sima Zhou.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，王濬以舟師至于建鄴之石頭，[27]孫皓大懼，面縳輿櫬，降于軍門。

translations.literal: On the day renyin of the third month Wang Jun’s fleet reached Shitou at Jianye [27]; Sun Hao was terrified, bound his own hands, and brought a coffin to surrender at the camp gate.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renyin: Wang Jun’s ships closed on Stone City [27]; Sun Hao came out bound, coffin in tow.

sentences.zh: 濬杖節解縛焚櫬，送于京都。

translations.literal: Jun, bearing the staff of authority, loosed his bonds, burned the coffin, and sent him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun freed him, burned the surrender coffin, and escorted him to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 收其圖籍，克州四，郡四十三，縣三百一十三，戶五十二萬三千，吏三萬二千，兵二十三萬，男女口二百三十萬。

translations.literal: They collected his maps and registers, took four provinces, forty-three commanderies, and three hundred thirteen counties, with five hundred twenty-three thousand households, thirty-two thousand officials, two hundred thirty thousand soldiers, and two million three hundred thousand persons of both sexes.
translations.idiomatic: The tally: four provinces, forty-three commanderies, three hundred thirteen counties, 523,000 households, 32,000 officials, 230,000 troops, and 2.3 million people.

sentences.zh: 其牧守已下皆因吳所置，除其苛政，示之簡易，吳人大悅。

translations.literal: From shepherds and prefects downward they kept Wu’s incumbents in place, removed harsh government, and showed them simplicity; the people of Wu were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Wu’s local officials stayed at their posts under lighter rule, and the south rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，[28]大赦，改元，大酺五日，恤孤老困窮。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou [28] there was a great amnesty, the reign title was changed, general feasting was held for five days, and orphans, the aged, and the destitute were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyou [28]: amnesty, new era name, five days of public feasting, and relief for the helpless.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，河東、高平雨雹，傷秋稼。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Hedong and Gaoping were struck by hail that injured the autumn crop.
translations.idiomatic: Summer hail in Hedong and Gaoping ruined crops.

sentences.zh: 遣兼侍中張側、黃門侍郎朱震分使揚越，慰其初附。

translations.literal: Concurrent palace attendant Zhang Ce and gentleman at the yellow gate Zhu Zhen were sent separately to Yang and Yue to console the newly submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys fanned out through the new south to reassure the conquered.

sentences.zh: 白麟見于頓丘。

translations.literal: A white unicorn was seen at Dunqiu.
translations.idiomatic: A white kirin appeared at Dunqiu.

sentences.zh: 三河、魏郡、弘農雨雹，傷宿麥。

translations.literal: Sanhe, Wei commandery, and Hongnong were struck by hail that injured the winter wheat.
translations.idiomatic: Hail in the heartland damaged the winter wheat.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，封孫皓爲歸命侯，拜其太子爲中郎，諸子爲郎中。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai Sun Hao was enfeoffed as marquis who returns his mandate; his crown prince was appointed gentleman of the interior, his sons gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: Xinhai: Sun Hao became “return-the-mandate” marquis while his sons received court sinecures.

sentences.zh: 吳之舊望，隨才擢敘。

translations.literal: Wu’s old notables were promoted and ordered according to their talents.
translations.idiomatic: Wu’s gentry elite were ranked by merit and given posts.

sentences.zh: 孫氏大將戰亡之家徙於壽陽，將吏渡江復十年，百姓及百工復二十年。

translations.literal: Households of Wu’s great generals who died in battle were moved to Shouyang; officers and clerks who crossed the Yangzi had labor remitted ten years, commoners and artisans twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: Fallen Wu generals’ families were resettled at Shouyang; southern officials got ten years’ tax holiday, commoners twenty.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，[29]帝臨軒大會，引皓升殿，群臣咸稱萬歲。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin [29] the emperor came to the gallery for a great assembly, led Hao up the hall, and the host of ministers cried “ten thousand years.”
translations.idiomatic: Bingyin [29]: Sun Hao was paraded before the court amid cheers.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，薦酃淥酒于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao fine wine from Luling was offered in the grand temple.
translations.idiomatic: Dingmao: Luling wine was poured for the ancestors.

sentences.zh: 郡國六雹，傷秋稼。

translations.literal: Six commanderies and principalities were struck by hail that injured the autumn crop.
translations.idiomatic: Six more provinces reported hail damage.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔諸士卒年六十以上罷歸于家。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu an edict ordered soldiers aged sixty and above dismissed home.
translations.idiomatic: Gengwu: veterans over sixty were sent home.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以王濬爲輔國大將軍、襄陽侯，杜預當陽侯，王戎安豐侯，唐彬上庸侯，賈充、琅邪王伷以下增封。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen Wang Jun was made great general who assists the state and marquis of Xiangyang, Du Yu marquis of Dangyang, Wang Rong marquis of Anfeng, Tang Bin marquis of Shangyong, and Jia Chong, king Zhou of Langye, and those below received increased fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Gengchen: Wang Jun, Du Yu, Wang Rong, and Tang Bin received marquisates while Jia Chong and Sima Zhou gained added revenue.

sentences.zh: 於是論功行封，賜公卿以下帛各有差。

translations.literal: Thereupon merit was weighed and enfeoffments granted, and silks were bestowed on the dukes and ministers downward, each according to difference.
translations.idiomatic: Silks followed to the whole bureaucracy graded by service.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，初置翊軍校尉官。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou of the sixth month the office of colonel of the flying guard was first established.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingchou: a new “flying guard” colonelcy was added.

sentences.zh: 封丹水侯睦爲高陽王。

translations.literal: Marquis Mu of Danshui was established as king of Gaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Mu regained kingship as ruler of Gaoyang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，東夷十國歸化。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen ten states of the eastern Yi submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Jiashen: ten Yi realms sent submission.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，虜軻成泥寇西平、浩亹，殺督將以下三百餘人。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the tribesman Kecheni raided Xiping and Gaomen, killing more than three hundred commanders and captains downward.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: steppe raider Kecheni hit Xiping and Gaomen, killing three hundred officers.

sentences.zh: 東夷二十國朝獻。

translations.literal: Twenty states of the eastern Yi came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty Yi embassies arrived at court.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以尚書魏舒爲尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin Wei Shu of the masters of writing was appointed senior vice-director of the masters of the right.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyin: Wei Shu became right vice-president.

sentences.zh: 八月，車師前部遣子入侍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the forward division of Cheshi sent a son as hostage at court.
translations.idiomatic: Cheshi’s forward king sent his heir to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 己未，封皇弟延祚爲樂平王。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei the imperial younger brother Yanzuo was enfeoffed as king of Leping.
translations.idiomatic: Jiwei: Prince Yanzuo became king of Leping.

sentences.zh: 白龍三見于永昌。

translations.literal: Three white dragons were seen at Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Three white dragons were reported in Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 九月，群臣以天下一統，屢請封襌，帝謙讓弗許。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the host of ministers, because the realm was unified, repeatedly requested the Feng and Shan sacrifices; the emperor modestly declined and did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers begged for the grand Feng-Shan rite on Mount Tai; the emperor refused out of modesty.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，除五女復。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi of the tenth month the exemption for households with five daughters was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Dingsi: the five-daughter corvée waiver was canceled.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，廣漢王贊薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen of the twelfth month king Zan of Guanghan died.
translations.idiomatic: Wuchen: Sima Zan of Guanghan died.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月，淮南、丹楊地震。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, second month, Huainan and Danyang suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Taikang 2, spring: Huainan and Danyang shook.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，安平王敦薨。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen of the third month king Dun of Anping died.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingshen: Sima Dun of Anping died.

sentences.zh: 賜王公以下吳生口各有差。

translations.literal: Captives from Wu below the rank of king and duke were bestowed on the nobility, each according to difference.
translations.idiomatic: Wu prisoners were parceled out to Jin nobles by rank.

sentences.zh: 詔選孫皓妓妾五千人入宮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered five thousand singing-girls and concubines of Sun Hao selected for the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Five thousand of Sun Hao’s harem women were drafted into the harem.

sentences.zh: 東夷五國朝獻。

translations.literal: Five states of the eastern Yi came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Five Yi states sent tribute that spring.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，東夷五國內附。

translations.literal: In summer, the sixth month, five states of the eastern Yi submitted within the borders.
translations.idiomatic: Summer: five more Yi peoples asked for enrollment.

sentences.zh: 郡國十六雨雹，大風拔樹，壞百姓廬舍。

translations.literal: Sixteen commanderies and principalities were struck by hail; great winds uprooted trees and ruined commoners’ huts.
translations.idiomatic: Hail and gales tore through sixteen provinces.

sentences.zh: 江夏、泰山水，流居人三百餘家。

translations.literal: Jiangxia and Mount Tai suffered floods that swept away more than three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Floods on the Yangzi and at Taishan displaced three hundred families.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，上黨又暴風雨雹，傷秋稼。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Shangdang again had violent wind, rain, and hail that injured the autumn crop.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Shangdang’s storms ruined the harvest.

sentences.zh: 八月，有星孛于張。

translations.literal: In the eighth month a broom star appeared in Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: August: a comet crossed the Zhang mansion.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，鮮卑慕容廆寇昌黎。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month Murong Hui of the Xianbei raided Changli.
translations.idiomatic: Winter: Xianbei chief Murong Hui struck Changli.

translations.literal: [30] Commentary marker thirty stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: [30] The recension marks commentary note thirty here.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁丑，罷秦州，并雍州。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on the day dingchou, Qin province was abolished and merged into Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Taikang 3, dingchou: Qin province was folded back into Yong.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以尚書張華都督幽州諸軍事。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu Zhang Hua of the masters of writing was appointed supervisor of all military affairs of You province.
translations.idiomatic: Jiawu: Zhang Hua took command on the Youzhou frontier.

sentences.zh: 三月，安北將軍嚴詢敗鮮卑慕容廆於昌黎，殺傷數萬人。

translations.literal: In the third month Yan Xun, general who guards the north, defeated Murong Hui of the Xianbei at Changli, killing or wounding several tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Yan Xun shattered Murong Hui at Changli with casualties in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙子，司徒、廣陸侯李胤薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day bingzi, Li Yin, steward of the masters of the people and marquis of Guanglu, died.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary bingzi: Li Yin, steward of the masters of the people, died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，白龍二見于濟南。

translations.literal: On the day guichou two white dragons were seen at Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Guichou: twin white dragons appeared at Jinan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，[31]罷平州、寧州刺史三年一入奏事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month [31], Ping province was abolished, and the practice whereby the inspector of Ning province journeyed to court once every three years to present memorials was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month [31]: Pingzhou was struck from the map, and Ning’s governor no longer had to make the old triennial appearance in Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 九月，東夷二十九國歸化，獻其方物。

translations.literal: In the ninth month twenty-nine states of the eastern Yi submitted and presented their local products.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-nine Yi realms sent tribute that autumn.

sentences.zh: 吳故將莞恭、帛奉舉兵反，攻害建鄴令，遂圍揚州，徐州刺史嵇喜討平之。

translations.literal: Former Wu generals Wan Gong and Bo Feng raised troops in revolt, killed the magistrate of Jianye, then besieged Yang province; Ji Xi, inspector of Xu province, campaigned and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Two ex-Wu officers, Wan Gong and Bo Feng, murdered the Jianye magistrate and besieged Yangzhou until Xu inspector Ji Xi crushed the rising.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月甲申，以司空齊王攸爲大司馬、督青州諸軍事，鎮東大將軍、琅邪王伷爲撫軍大將軍，[32]汝南王亮爲太尉，光祿大夫山濤爲司徒，尚書令衛瓘爲司空。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen of winter, twelfth month, Sima You, king of Qi and minister of works, was made grand marshal and supervisor of all military affairs of Qing province; Sima Zhou, great general who guards the east and king of Langye, was made great general who pacifies the army [32]; Sima Liang, king of Runan, grand commandant; Shan Tao, grand officer of brilliant prosperity, steward of the masters of the people; Wei Guan, supervisor of the masters of writing, minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Jiashen: a top-level shuffle—Sima You to grand marshal on the Qing front, Sima Zhou to pacification command [32], Sima Liang to grand commandant, Shan Tao to steward, Wei Guan to minister of works.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔四方水旱甚者無出田租。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen an edict ordered that regions suffering severe flood or drought pay no field rent.
translations.idiomatic: Bingshen: disaster counties were forgiven their grain rent.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月甲申，[33]以尚書右僕射魏舒爲尚書左僕射，下邳王晃爲尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the day jiashen [33], Wei Shu, senior vice-director of the masters of the right, was appointed senior vice-director of the masters of the left, and king Huang of Xiapi senior vice-director of the masters of the right.
translations.idiomatic: Taikang 4, jiashen [33]: Wei Shu and Sima Huang took the left and right vice-presidencies.

sentences.zh: 戊午，司徒山濤薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Shan Tao, steward of the masters of the people, died.
translations.idiomatic: Wuwu: Shan Tao died.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，立長樂亭侯寔爲北海王。

translations.literal: On the day jichou of the second month Shi, marquis of Changleting, was established as king of Beihai.
translations.idiomatic: Jichou: Shi was promoted from Changle village marquis to king of Beihai.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，任城王陵薨。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month king Ling of Rencheng died.
translations.idiomatic: Summer: Sima Ling of Rencheng died.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，大將軍、琅邪王伷薨。

translations.literal: On the day jihai of the fifth month Sima Zhou, great general and king of Langye, died.
translations.idiomatic: Jihai: Sima Zhou, king of Langye, died.

sentences.zh: 徙遼東王蕤爲東萊王。

translations.literal: King Rui of Liaodong was transferred to be king of Donglai.
translations.idiomatic: The Liaodong princedom was downgraded to Donglai for Sima Rui.

sentences.zh: 六月，增九卿禮秩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the ritual stipends of the nine ministers were increased.
translations.idiomatic: June: salaries for the nine chamberlains were raised.

sentences.zh: 牂柯獠二千餘落內屬。

translations.literal: More than two thousand settlements of Zangke Liao submitted as subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Over two thousand Zangke Liao hamlets enrolled under Jin.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，以尚書右僕射、下邳王晃爲都督青州諸軍事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day renzi, king Huang of Xiapi, senior vice-director of the masters of the right, was appointed supervisor of all military affairs of Qing province.
translations.idiomatic: Renzi: Sima Huang took Qing military command.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，兗州大水，復其田租。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin Yan province suffered great floods and its field rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Bingyin: Yanzhou floods brought tax relief.

sentences.zh: 八月，鄯善國遣子入侍，假其歸義侯。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the state of Shanshan sent a son as hostage at court and he was given the acting title marquis who returns to righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Shanshan sent a royal hostage and received the “return to righteousness” marquis title.

sentences.zh: 以隴西王泰爲尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: King Tai of Longxi was appointed senior vice-director of the masters of the right.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Tai of Longxi joined the secretariat as right vice-president.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊午，新都王該薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu of the eleventh month king Gai of Xindu died.
translations.idiomatic: Wuwu: Sima Gai of Xindu died.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左僕射魏舒爲司徒。

translations.literal: Wei Shu of the masters of writing was appointed steward of the masters of the people.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Shu became steward of the masters of the people.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，大閱于宣武觀。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu of the twelfth month a grand review was held at the Xuanwu stand.
translations.idiomatic: Gengwu: another parade at Xuanwu.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河內及荊州、揚州大水。

translations.literal: That year Henan and Jing and Yang provinces suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Floods ravaged the interior and the middle Yangzi that year.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月己亥，青龍二見于武庫井中。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the day jihai, two azure dragons were seen in the armory well.
translations.idiomatic: Taikang 5, jihai: two blue dragons in the Luoyang arsenal well.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，立南宮王子玷爲長樂王。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin of the second month Dian, son of the king of the southern palace, was established as king of Changle.
translations.idiomatic: Bingyin: Prince Dian of the southern palace became king of Changle.

sentences.zh: [35]壬辰，地震。

translations.literal: [35] On the day renchen there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: [35] Renchen: the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，任城、魯國池水赤如血。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the waters of pools in Rencheng and Lu principality turned red as blood.
translations.idiomatic: Summer: ponds in Rencheng and Lu ran blood-red.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，宣帝廟梁折。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu of the fifth month a beam in emperor Xuan’s temple broke.
translations.idiomatic: Bingwu: a roof-beam snapped in Gaozu’s temple.

sentences.zh: 六月，初置黃沙獄。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Yellow Sand prison was first established.
translations.idiomatic: June: the “Yellow Sand” review prison was created.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，皇子恢薨。

translations.literal: On the day wushen of autumn, seventh month, the imperial son Hui died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wushen: Prince Hui died.

sentences.zh: 任城、梁國、中山雨雹，傷秋稼。

translations.literal: Rencheng, Liang principality, and Zhongshan were struck by hail that injured the autumn crop.
translations.idiomatic: Hailstorms in Rencheng, Liang, and Zhongshan ruined crops.

sentences.zh: 減天下戶課三分之一。

translations.literal: Household levies empire-wide were reduced by one third.
translations.idiomatic: The head tax was cut by a third across the realm.

sentences.zh: 九月，南安大風折木，郡國五大水，隕霜，傷秋稼。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Nan’an had great wind that broke trees; five commanderies and principalities had great floods; killing frost injured the autumn crop.
translations.idiomatic: September brought gales, floods in five provinces, and black frost.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲辰，太原王輔薨。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen of winter, eleventh month, king Fu of Taiyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: Jiachen: Sima Fu of Taiyuan died.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu of the twelfth month there was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Gengwu: general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 林邑、大秦國各遣使來獻。

translations.literal: Lin-yi and Da Qin each sent envoys to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast and Roman embassies arrived with gifts.

sentences.zh: 閏月，鎮南大將軍、當陽侯杜預卒。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month Du Yu, great general who guards the south and marquis of Dangyang, died.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month: Du Yu died.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月甲申朔，[36]以比歲不登，免租貸宿負。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on the first day jiashen [36], because harvests had failed for successive years, rent was remitted and old granary debts forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: Taikang 6, new moon jiashen [36]: years of poor harvests brought rent remission and canceled grain loans.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以征南大將軍王渾爲尚書左僕射，尚書褚䂮都督揚州諸軍事，楊濟都督荊州諸軍事。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen Wang Hun, great general who campaigns south, was appointed senior vice-director of the masters of the left; Chu Xian of the masters of writing supervisor of all military affairs of Yang province; Yang Ji supervisor of all military affairs of Jing province.
translations.idiomatic: Wuchen: Wang Hun to the secretariat, Chu Xian to Yang command, Yang Ji to Jing.

sentences.zh: 三月，郡國六隕霜，傷桑麥。

translations.literal: In the third month six commanderies and principalities had killing frost that injured mulberry and wheat.
translations.idiomatic: March frost hurt mulberries and wheat in six jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，扶南等十國來獻，參離四千餘落內附。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, ten states including Funan came to present tribute, and more than four thousand settlements of Shenli submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Summer: Southeast embassies arrived and four thousand Shenli hamlets yielded.

sentences.zh: 郡國四旱，十大水，壞百姓廬舍。

translations.literal: Four commanderies and principalities had drought; ten had great floods that ruined commoners’ huts.
translations.idiomatic: Four provinces baked while ten flooded.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，巴西地震。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Ba-Xi suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Ba-Xi shook.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, bingxu, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, new moon bingxu: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 減百姓綿絹三分之一。

translations.literal: Silk owed by commoners was reduced by one third.
translations.idiomatic: The silk portion of the poll tax was cut by a third.

sentences.zh: 白龍見于京兆。

translations.literal: A white dragon was seen in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: A white dragon appeared in the Jingzhao capital region.

sentences.zh: 以鎮軍大將軍王濬爲撫軍大將軍。

translations.literal: Wang Jun, great general who guards the army, was appointed great general who pacifies the army.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun traded “guard the army” for “pacify the army” generalship.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，山陽公劉康薨。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi of the ninth month Liu Kang, mountain-yang duke, died.
translations.idiomatic: Bingzi: Liu Kang, last Han-title noble, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，南安山崩，水出。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month Nan’an’s mountains collapsed and water burst forth.
translations.idiomatic: Winter: landslides and flash floods in Nan’an.

sentences.zh: 南陽郡獲兩足獸。

translations.literal: Nanyang commandery captured a two-footed beast.
translations.idiomatic: Nanyang reported a two-legged freak beast.

sentences.zh: 龜茲、焉耆國遣子入侍。

translations.literal: Qiuci and Yanqi each sent a son as hostage at court.
translations.idiomatic: Qiuci and Yanqi sent royal hostages.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，大閱于宣武觀，旬日而罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen of the twelfth month a grand review was held at the Xuanwu stand and ended after ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Jiashen: a ten-day army review at Xuanwu.

sentences.zh: 庚子，撫軍大將軍、襄陽侯王濬卒。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Wang Jun, great general who pacifies the army and marquis of Xiangyang, died.
translations.idiomatic: Gengzi: Wang Jun died.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲寅朔，日有蝕之。
